name: Power-Assisted Bicycle
description: An e-bike: a bicycle with handlebars, pedals and no more than three wheels, whose electric motors total 500 W or less and stop assisting at 32 km/h, pedal-assist or throttle; one over 500 W, without working pedals, or gas-powered is a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: Handlebar steering, pedals, no more than three wheels, and can be propelled by pedalling
restrictions.citation: The Registration Exemption and Reciprocity Regulations, 2014, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 13, s. 2(1)(f)

restrictions.rule: Electric motors with a total continuous power output rating of 500 W or less, measured at each motor's shaft, that give no further assistance at 32 km/h on level ground
restrictions.citation: The Registration Exemption and Reciprocity Regulations, 2014, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 13, s. 2(1)(f)

restrictions.rule: Pedal assistance stops as soon as the rider stops pedalling; throttle assistance stops as soon as the brakes are applied
restrictions.citation: The Registration Exemption and Reciprocity Regulations, 2014, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 13, s. 2(1)(f)

restrictions.rule: Needs a driver-operated motor on/off switch separate from the throttle, or a mechanism that keeps the motor from engaging below 3 km/h
restrictions.citation: The Registration Exemption and Reciprocity Regulations, 2014, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 13, s. 2(1)(f)

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 14 or older on a highway
restrictions.citation: The Traffic Safety Act, S.S. 2004, c. T-18.1, s. 247.1(a)

restrictions.rule: The rider and any passenger must wear a strapped-on motorcycle helmet or a CSA, Snell, ANSI or ASTM bicycle helmet
restrictions.citation: The Traffic Safety Act, S.S. 2004, c. T-18.1, s. 247.1(b); The Vehicle Equipment Regulations, 1987, R.R.S. c. V-2.1 Reg 10, s. 6.1(1.2) and (2.1)

restrictions.rule: No driver's licence and no registration
restrictions.citation: The Driver Licensing and Suspension Regulations, 2006, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 2, s. 11.1(c); The Registration Exemption and Reciprocity Regulations, 2014, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 13, s. 2(2)(e)

restrictions.rule: Ridden under the rules of the road that apply to bicycles, and not where a municipal bylaw restricts it; a city may require a bicycle sticker
One over 500 W, without working pedals, or with a gas engine is a motorcycle and needs a motorcycle licence and equipment
